in_sanskrit.name: Shakar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweet
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shakar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is full of joy and sweetness

in_hindi.name: शाकर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shakar in Hindi is derived from the Hindi word शाकर (shākara), which means 'sweet', 'sugary', or 'syrupy'. It is often used as a nickname or term of endearment for someone who is sweet-natured or has a sweet tooth.

in_tamil.name: Shakar
in_tamil.long_meaning: Shakar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is full of joy and sweetness

in_telugu.name: Shakar
in_telugu.long_meaning: Shakar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is full of joy and sweetness

in_marathi.name: Shakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is full of joy and sweetness

in_bengali.name: Shakar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shakar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is full of joy and sweetness
